answer: Each established member holds five vouch slots per epoch as walnut seals. A sponsor locks 50 credits behind a newcomer until one verified task; the registry carries an echo of every vouch, catching dupes. Slots cannot wander between sponsors; a sponsor caught vouching for a sybil loses the slot plus the bond. A farmer needing 1,000 fake identities must recruit 200 sponsors and lock 50,000 credits, so marginal cost rises per sponsor. The failure mode is slot farming: rented slots still count against the five and burn on exposure. An honest newcomer needs one seal.
